hints.content: $\displaystyle \int_{2}^{2} h(x) \, dx$ is the net area between $h(x)$ and the $x$-axis from $x = 2$ to $x = 2$.
There is no area from $x = 2$ to $x = 2$ since the width of the interval is $0$.
